# UI vendor

These small local adapters use the MIT licensed Radix UI primitives and the
shadcn/ui New York v4 source conventions. The upstream references are:

- https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/new-york-v4/button.json
- https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/new-york-v4/input.json
- https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/new-york-v4/dialog.json
- https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/new-york-v4/alert-dialog.json
- https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/new-york-v4/popover.json
- https://www.radix-ui.com/primitives/docs/components/dialog
- https://www.radix-ui.com/primitives/docs/components/alert-dialog

Imports are kept here so application screens depend on Tacitus adapters.
